title: 2-1: hold the gold
prompt: Stage 2-1, 14 gold, level 3, three 1-cost units on the board and nothing paired. The shop has nothing you own. What do you do this round?

options.label: Buy the second copy of your tank, then stop. Keep the rest toward 50.

explanation:
At 2-1 gold is worth more later than now: every 10 gold you bank earns 1 gold of interest per round, all game. The shop shows a copy of a unit you own, so buy it: pairs are how you get 2-stars for free. Then stop. Rolling here finds nothing you can use for long, and levelling to 4 at 2-1 buys one extra 1-cost body for gold that would be earning interest.

You reach level 4 naturally at 2-2 with the free XP anyway.
principle: Buy pairs, bank the rest. Rolling and levelling in stage 2 are exceptions, not the plan.
commonMistake: Rolling at 2-1 because there is nothing to do with the gold, which is exactly why you should keep it.
